prompt: Design the agent architecture described by requirements.json. Write the implementable design to valid JSON in design.json; do not build or run it. If multiple agents are not justified, say so in the design and use a single-agent architecture.

assertions.description: Design compares single and multi-agent cost and names the selected benefit
Topology uses bounded manager-worker fan-out and aggregation
Executable roles have typed contracts, limits, criteria, and escalation
Provider and global ceilings, budgets, read-only policy, and approval are enforced
Recovery, traceability, cost, timing, and evidence validation are specified
